NAME: Nugget
LINE: Look! An abandoned farm!

NAME: Nima
LINE: The gate on my map had a crooked weathervane just like that one. I think we're meant to rest here.

NAME: Shaz
LINE: Or it's a trap and a cursed beast is up for a feast... Either way, dibs on the hayloft.

NAME: Nugget
LINE: No big bad beast eats Nugget! I'll peck it into straw!

NAME: Nima
LINE: There there... Nobody's eating anyone!

NAME: Nima
LINE: ...Ahhh!

NAME: Nugget
LINE: Unhand her, beast! Feel the wrath of my sharp talons!

NAME: Shaz
LINE: Nugget, calm your feathers, Nima is—

NAME: Nima
LINE: ..Soooo excited for these hidden, uncursed ripe pumpkins and carrots! We could harvest enough for days!

NAME: Nima
LINE: Shaz, can you help me with them?

NAME: Shaz
LINE: Yeah, I can help! Though I should warn you, my harvesting fee is one carrot per basket... triple that if I have to deal with the crows!

NAME: Nima
LINE: Fair enough, hard work deserves fair pay! I'll count out your carrots first.

NAME: Shaz
LINE: Well... don't forget that I also require a break every ten minutes in the shade.

NAME: Nima
LINE: The townspeople told me there's a caldera not too far from here. I suppose it can get pretty hot all of a sudden, so proper rest makes sense.

NAME: Shaz
LINE: ...And remember to carefully groom my fur against the humidity so I stay handsome!

NAME: Nima
LINE: Don't worry, I have plenty of experience. I used to take care of all the farm animals back home.

NAME: Shaz
LINE: W-Wait... I was clearly joking! Don't lump me in with the livestock!

NAME: Nima
LINE: Hehe, fair point. Sorry, your ears were twitching so much that I really thought you liked the idea.

NAME: Shaz
LINE: T-That's just the caldera breeze! Ready to dig or what, farmgirl?

NAME: Nugget
LINE: Wait for Nugget! My beak can dig twice as fast!
